svg.title: Context-assisted QA workflow benchmark
svg.desc: A frozen task and identical application feed baseline and context-guided conditions. Both use the same Gemma model and bounded tools. The agent reads evidence, edits or decides, verifies and repairs. Independent grading freezes the result; public summaries flow to GitHub and the deployed dashboard.
svg.text: Can useful context help an agent finish QA work?
Create tests • Update tests • Validate proposed scenarios
Freeze the same task and application
Identical source, existing tests, helpers and environment
Baseline
Discover evidence using repository tools
No custom framework bootstrap
Context-guided
Instructions + skill + task context + resolver
Same helpers, with framework guidance
Same local Gemma model and bounded Pi agent host
Read / search → edit or decide → verify → inspect feedback → repair
15 minutes • 36 model calls • 80 tools • 3 verification snapshots
Wall-clock watchdogs • pause detection • every attempt recorded
Audit timing, then grade the frozen submission
Healthy behavior + targeted faults + preserved coverage + scope
Invalid runs stay visible; semantic judgments stay pending until reviewed
Private raw evidence → public summary → GitHub → live dashboard
The dashboard refreshes the workflow feed automatically; no manual import
Synthetic API pilot: one pair per task. Human effort and local operating cost remain unmeasured.
